text:
incidents-bot: ALERT: high decode tail latency detected in eu-west clusters. p99 decode latency up 4x, streaming stalls rising. paging events spike on gpunode-2a*. See metrics: https://metrics.redwood.internal/alerts/3129998888 :rotating_light:

eileen_oncall: got it. I’m looking at the dashboard now. p95 also creeping above SLO on streaming endpoints. Opening thread.

raj_runtime: I saw a correlated deploy earlier this morning — TRT8 + new FlashAttention kernels pushed to the eu-west pool around 08:12 UTC. Could be related.

miguel_sre: Confirmed. Kernel compilepath churn around that time. Kernel pages/sec increased and nvml reports memory pressure on nodes running tpu-emulation containers.

tiffany_prod: Any customer-facing impact? Any SLA hits or active support tickets?

sam_support: Two customers reported degraded streaming in the last 15m (support ticket #7891, #7892). One is a high-traffic sandbox. I flagged prioritization.

eileen_oncall: Immediate triage plan: 1) pin routing away from eu-west for streaming-heavy live traffic; 2) temp rollback of the TRT8/FlashAttn variant on a canary subset; 3) collect heap/paging logs and kernel ooms. Assigning raj + miguel.

raj_runtime: On it. Starting a canary rollback on pool eu-west-rt-3: `kubectl -n inference set image ds/rt-runtime runtime=image:redwood/rt:2026-03-10-legacy` will fallback to previous kernels. I’ll keep one node as-is for forensics.

deploy-bot: Rollout triggered by @raj_runtime: rollout/rt-runtime (eu-west-rt-3) started.

miguel_sre: Also adding an eviction threshold tweak to reduce page-in churn: `/sre/adjust --cluster eu-west --param page_eviction_threshold=0.75`. Applying now.

raj_runtime: Canary started. Early logs show decode tail dropping on canary nodes within 90s. p99 for canary down ~35%.

eileen_oncall: Nice. Start gradual routing shift: `route-manage set-policy streaming eu-west prefer=other-regions percent=60` — move 60% of streaming traffic off eu-west.

tiffany_prod: Communication note: telling affected customers we’re investigating kernel-level regression and routing workarounds. ETA TBD — will update in 30m.

sam_support: Posted initial update to the two tickets and assigned to eng-runtime. Customers asked for timeline; asked to be prioritized.

leadsre: Important: collect `dmesg` and `journalctl -k` entries before we finish canary. Also capture `/proc/vmstat` and kernel compile flags from the image. We need a reproducible signal for the regression.

raj_runtime: Captured logs: attached snippets (truncated):
```
[eviction] pagecache reclaim caused stall: reclaim scanned=1024 inactive=768
trt_kernel: flash_attn init took 123ms, fallback path engaged for seq>1024
decode: kv-cache pagefaults escalate, tail latency ++
```

miguel_sre: Running `perf probe` and `pagemap` dumps now. Also seeing a spike in `context_switches` correlated with the high tail. Suspect a pathological kernel scheduler interaction with the new kernels + FlashAttention memory patterns.

raj_runtime: Given canary success, I recommend pausing the original rollout and promoting the canary rollback to the rest of eu-west. Will also open an L4 PR to revert the compile flag `-ftls-model=global-dynamic` introduced in the last compile.

eileen_oncall: Do the rollback promote. I'll coordinate the customer updates and on-call handoff in 45min. Also we need an incident severity and postmortem owner.

miguel_sre: Promoting rollback now. `kubectl rollout restart daemonset/rt-runtime -n inference --selector=pool=eu-west-rt --image=image:redwood/rt:2026-03-10-legacy`

deploy-bot: Rollout promotion started by @miguel_sre.

tiffany_prod: Setting SEV-2 for now because p99 sustained > SLO and multiple customers affected. Assigning postmortem to @raj_runtime.

sam_support: Customers updated: we routed traffic and promoted rollback. They reported immediate improvement in a few minutes for the sandbox customer. Keeping ticket open.

leadsre: Good. Next steps: 1) reproduce locally with the failing kernel + flashattn build, 2) bisect compile flags to narrow root cause, 3) monitor p95/p99 for 2 hours after full rollback before closing the incident.

raj_runtime: Noted. I'll start the bisect and spin up repro nodes. Will also engage FlashAttention upstream maintainers — pinging them: @flashattn-team.

eileen_oncall: Oncall handoff: @eileen_oncall -> @miguel_sre in 45m. If p99 rises again, escalate to on-call channel and ping leadsre.

incidents-bot: UPDATE: p99 back to baseline on eu-west after full promotion ~12m. Paging events dropped to normal thresholds. Alert auto-resolved.

tiffany_prod: Great. I'll draft postmortem template and note customer impact.

raj_runtime: Recording follow-up tasks in the runbook: bisect compile flags, add a canary gating that runs paging memory-pressure synthetic tests, and improve alerting to correlate kernel compile pushes with p99 spikes.

sam_support: Will follow up with customers and close tickets once they confirm stability.

eileen_oncall: Thanks team. Leaving notes in the incident tracker and will hand off. :white_check_mark:
